body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs`, `packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs`, and `packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs` define hand-rolled `makeTmp` and `cleanup` helpers with manual `try/finally` blocks and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTmp()` with `tmp(t, 'model-router-floor-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { cleanup(dir); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete local `makeTmp` and `cleanup` helpers.
2. In `packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTmp()` with `tmp(t, 'model-router-test-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { cleanup(dir); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete local `makeTmp` and `cleanup` helpers.
3. In `packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace local `makeTmp()` with `tmp(t)`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { cleanup(dir); }` blocks, unindenting test bodies.
   - Delete local `makeTmp` and `cleanup` helpers.
4. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs'` and `'packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
5. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/model-router` exits 0 with all 75 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'cleanup' packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs` is 0, 0, and 0.
   - `grep -c 'makeTmp' packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs` is 0, 0, and 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'cleanup' packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs` is 0, 0, and 0.
- AC2 `grep -c 'makeTmp' packages/model-router/test/floor-zero.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/model-router.test.mjs packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs` is 0, 0, and 0.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/model-router/test/(floor-zero|model-router)\.test\.mjs' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/model-router` exits 0 with all 75 tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(model-router): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 32 try/finally blocks in model-router tests
